repair execution, training, ranking, and paper/current-sim verdicts require measured rollout evidence
supersedes: direct measured execution without a frozen denominator and claim boundary
ranking effective candidates from reset-only evidence
interpreting reset validation as scenario redesign success

public_gates: M2396 must design measured validation over M2394 reset-ready effective candidates without running rollout
M2396 must freeze denominator, artifact inputs, controller/checkpoint source, duplicate policy, metrics, and guardrails before execution
M2396 must distinguish candidate-scenario references from unique reset targets and measured episodes
M2396 must keep repair execution, training, ranking, winner selection, paper finite-window-vs-GRU, current-sim verdict, and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: freezes a measured-validation design for reset-ready effective candidate artifacts after reset adapter audit
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rollout execution, repair execution, controller ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if the design cannot define a fixed denominator from M2391/M2394 artifacts
stop if metric semantics would mix reset validity with rollout success
stop if duplicate candidate-scenario references are counted as independent reset evidence without pack/scenario identity
stop if design routes directly to ranking, training, repair success, or paper conclusion
stop if actor contract or effective candidate lineage is ambiguous
fallback_plan: route to measurement protocol repair if denominator or metrics are ambiguous
route to measured-validation implementation only if design is bounded and non-ranking
route to branch synthesis if another non-executable artifact step is proposed before measured validation

training_stage.stage_objective: measured validation design over reset-ready effective candidates

allowed_updates: M2396 status queue scoreboard research log and review

next_stage_criteria: artifact inputs and duplicate policy are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2396 designs measured validation and does not test history necessity.

self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2391 effective candidate artifacts, M2394 reset validation, and M2395 reset result audit.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If measured-validation design is incomplete, classify the protocol gap before running rollout.
allowed_claims: measured-validation design over reset-ready effective candidate artifacts
no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

duplicate policy for candidate-scenario references and measured episodes is specified

role metrics and failure semantics are specified
ranking, winner selection, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, current-sim verdict, and level3 self-ID claims remain blocked
